title: Rosemary Beach: Happy Ours in Seacrest Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Happy Ours in Seacrest Beach.
description_expanded:
Property includes private beach access at Sunset Beach, and pool access at the large Lagoon Pool. Beach service chairs can be rented through La Dolce Vita. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to "Happy Ours," your perfect coastal retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach. This spacious and beautifully appointed vacation rental offers everything you need for an unforgettable beach getaway.

Prime Location: Situated just across from the stunning Lagoon Pool, "Happy Ours" provides easy access to Seacrest Beach with a convenient tram service. Explore the charming Rosemary Beach community with complimentary fitness and tennis amenities just a short distance away.

Ample Accommodations: This exquisite property features four bedrooms with en suite bathrooms, ensuring privacy and comfort for all guests. Additionally, there is a cozy bunk room for extra sleeping space, making it perfect for families and larger groups.

Thoughtful Amenities: Enjoy two spacious living rooms for relaxation and entertainment, as well as plenty of parking for your convenience. Four complimentary adult bikes allow you to explore the surrounding areas with ease.

Inviting Interiors: The bright and airy first-floor living, dining, and kitchen areas create a welcoming atmosphere for gatherings. The well-equipped kitchen is perfect for preparing delicious meals to enjoy with loved ones.

REQUIRES 7 NIGHTS SATURDAY TO SATURDAY DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER
